column1: # Known differences between scopeio and Bio-Formats (which reads Philips TIFF as plain TIFF).
# JPEG tiles are YCbCr 4:2:0: decoders upsample the chroma differently. Checked on Philips-1 tile (40, 30)
# against ImageMagick (libjpeg, black box): samples within 4, channel means within 0.45; Bio-Formats
# Tiles that are not stored (offset and byte count 0): scopeio returns white, the slide background
# that OpenSlide also renders; Bio-Formats returns black.
